title: Concept: Link to a PostgreSQL web console
description: A link to a phpPgAdmin installation in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: phpPgAdmin runs SQL with the credentials in its configuration and is a frequent target for credential theft and remote code execution through database functions.
applicability: A reachable console means database-level access once one credential is guessed or reused.
risk: Database consoles must not be discoverable from an application response.
